NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: This page doesn’t exist (anymore). The link may be old.
NotFound.choreographyBody: It doesn’t exist, was archived, or you are not part of it. Ask the choreographer to add you if you should have access.

Home.title: Schedule
Home.heading: Plan choreographies and track availability
Home.intro: Everything your association needs to bring choreographies from the studio to the stage.

choreographies.title: Choreography management
choreographies.description: Organize pieces, choreographers, groups, participants, rehearsals, and performances in one place.

resources.title: Choreography resources
resources.description: Keep videos, music, documents, and other useful materials together with each choreography.

planning.title: Smart rehearsal planning
planning.description: Collect availability, spot conflicts, and build schedules that work for every participant.

calendar.title: Google Calendar synchronization
calendar.description: Sync rehearsals and events with Google Calendar so everyone stays up to date.

ResetPassword.title: Set a new password
ResetPassword.help: Choose a new password for this account. The reset link can only be used once.
ResetPassword.invalid: This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Ask an admin for a new one.

Unavailability.title: My unavailability
Unavailability.intro: Mark periods when you are not available. Click a date to mark the whole day, click it again to clear it, or use the calendar to draw, move, and resize blocks.
Unavailability.adminIntro: Mark periods when you or another member are not available. Choose whose calendar to edit, then draw, move, and resize blocks as usual.

Scheduling.title: Scheduling
Scheduling.intro: Build an optimized rehearsal weekend: pick pieces, days, and locations, then choose one of the generated calendars. Confirming creates the rehearsals.

Events.title: Events
Events.introAll: All association events, including rehearsals, representations, demonstrations, competitions, and festivals.
Events.introRelevant: Events you created, participate in, or that are linked to your choreographies.
Events.emptyCreate: No events yet. Create your first one.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.intro: Configure association-wide options, listed locations, tags, and members.

Choreographies.title: Choreographies
Choreographies.intro: By default this list shows choreographies you created, choreograph, or participate in.

ChoreographyDetail.upcomingEventCount: {count, plural, =0 {No upcoming dates} one {# upcoming date} other {# upcoming dates}}

ChoreographyRehearsalStatistics.title: Rehearsal statistics
ChoreographyRehearsalStatistics.noParticipants: No participants on this choreography yet.

UserDetail.transferOwnershipIntro: Transfer the owner role to another user. You will become a regular user. This is the only way to change who holds the owner role.
UserDetail.deleteUserIntro: Remove this person from the association. They leave every event and choreography. Pieces and events they created are kept and reassigned to you when needed.

Activity.title: My activity
Activity.rehearsalsMissed: {count, plural, =0 {no absences} one {# absence} other {# absences}}
Activity.noRehearsals: No past rehearsals in this period.
Activity.monthsCaption: Rehearsals and events you took part in
Activity.dancing: {count, plural, =0 {none danced} one {# danced} other {# danced}}

Activity.declaredNote: Based on your answers: the app does not record actual attendance.

CalendarFeed.title: Calendar subscription
CalendarFeed.intro: Get your events in your calendar app: Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, DigiCal… The link updates by itself when an event changes.
CalendarFeed.typesHint: “Mine”: rehearsals of your casts (except those you are unavailable for) and the events you take part in. Changing a choice changes the link: subscribe to the new one.
CalendarFeed.nothingSelected: Pick at least one event type.
CalendarFeed.noteOneWay: One way: changes made in your calendar do not come back to the app.
CalendarFeed.noteDelay: Your calendar re-reads the link regularly: Apple and DigiCal every 15 min to 1 h, Outlook every few hours, Google every 12 to 24 h.
CalendarFeed.noteSecret: This link gives access to your schedule: do not share it. If in doubt, regenerate it.
CalendarFeed.regenerateConfirm: Create a new link? Calendars subscribed to the old one will stop updating.
CalendarFeed.disableConfirm: Turn the link off? Subscribed calendars will stop updating.
CalendarFeed.error: That did not work. Try again.
CalendarFeed.copyError: Could not copy: select the link and copy it.
CalendarFeed.androidDigiCal: On Android (DigiCal…): use “Add to Google Calendar” above, or the ICSx⁵ app (paste the link there). The calendar then shows in your calendar app.

Share.title: Add a resource
Share.missed: The share could not be received. Open TRACker once, then share again.
Share.howTo: From your gallery (Android): pick a video, tap Share, then TRACker. It lands here, ready to add to a choreography.
Share.howToIphone: On iPhone, add the video from the choreography: Resources → +.
Share.noChoreography: Only choreographers and admins can add resources to a choreography.
Share.noStorage: File uploads are not configured on this server.
Share.tooBig: This file is {size}; the limit is {max}. Shorten the video or film in 1080p.
Share.descriptionPlaceholder: E.g. Rehearsal of 16 November, full run
